summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state initialized in the constructor and set/cleared in run_async (cleared in finally). Added tests/test_concurrency.py with 10 tests; all pass on the venv Python 3.9 when run with PYTHONPATH=src, because the venv's editable textual install points at base/. Nothing committed. Wider suite (excluding snapshot_tests, cli, devtools) shows 68 failures, mostly async tests/fixtures that don't run because pytest-asyncio is missing from the venv; I did not verify these against an unmodified baseline.
